# Net stable funding ratio (`nsfr` v1)

Basel III NSFR: available against required stable funding over one year.

**Group:** Liquidity · **Mnemonic:** `NSFR` · **Identifiers:** `NSFR-…` in `nsfrId`

Open one with `NSFR <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: nsfr
version: 1
description: "Basel III NSFR: available against required stable funding over one year."
match: { kind: nsfr, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Liquidity · Net stable funding ratio, id: $.nsfrId }
strip:
  - { label: Entity, bind: $.legalEntityName }
  - { label: NSFR, bind: $.nsfr, fmt: pct0, emphasis: true }
  - { label: ASF, bind: $.asfTotal, fmt: compact }
  - { label: RSF, bind: $.rsfTotal, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Minimum, bind: $.minimum, fmt: pct0 }
panels:
  - id: asf
    kind: table
    title: Available stable funding
    key: F2
    rows: $.asf
    columns:
      - { label: Source, bind: "@.category" }
      - { label: Amount, bind: "@.amount", fmt: compact }
      - { label: Factor, bind: "@.factor", fmt: pct0 }
      - { label: Weighted, bind: "@.weighted", fmt: compact, total: true }
  - id: rsf
    kind: table
    title: Required stable funding
    key: F3
    rows: $.rsf
    columns:
      - { label: Asset, bind: "@.category" }
      - { label: Amount, bind: "@.amount", fmt: compact }
      - { label: Factor, bind: "@.factor", fmt: pct0 }
      - { label: Weighted, bind: "@.weighted", fmt: compact, total: true }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
